WITH large AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(k_symbol, '')) = '' THEN '(blank)' ELSE k_symbol END AS grp,
         amount
  FROM "order"
  WHERE amount >= 2802
),
per AS (
  SELECT grp, AVG(amount) AS avg_amt
  FROM large
  GROUP BY grp
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS ov FROM per
)
SELECT per.grp AS k_symbol,
       per.avg_amt AS avg_amount,
       per.avg_amt - overall.ov AS excess_over_overall
FROM per, overall
WHERE per.avg_amt > overall.ov
ORDER BY excess_over_overall DESC
